Meet Heather

One chair. One stylist.

Heather's Hair Fashions

Heather's Hair Fashions is a small hair studio on Hillcrest Ave in Souderton, PA. Published reviews describe a one-client-at-a-time studio run by the stylist Heather, known for color and highlights.

Services run from balayage and keratin treatments to extensions, wig installs, braiding, and weaves. Appointments are by phone or through Fresha; when you book, the chair is yours.
